title: What If Pet Pythons Were Released in the Everglades?

scenes.text: What if pet pythons were let loose in a national park? Raccoons nearly disappeared.
Burmese pythons came from the pet trade, and by 2000 they were officially established in Florida.
Researchers compared road surveys from the 1990s with 2003 to 2011.
Raccoon sightings fell about 99 percent. Opossums fell about 99 percent too.
Bobcat sightings dropped about 88 percent, and the losses were biggest where pythons had lived longest.
Small rodents slightly increased. One released pet reshaped the food web of a whole park.

description:
What if pet pythons were released into the Everglades?
